acceptance_criteria: AC-1 Stage 0 / result algebra (contract 4.1, 5.0): a new module resolves the union tag from D1 alone -- SURFACE_PRESENT -> RESOLVED, SURFACE_ABSENT -> OMITTED{NOT_SHIPPED}, D1 missing/malformed -> OMITTED{SURFACE_ELIGIBILITY_UNRESOLVABLE} (fail closed). OMITTED is a structurally distinct type carrying reason + optional diagnostic and NO capability outputs (not None-filled fields). Cases V-A..V-D each tested.

AC-2 Vocabulary (4.2, 4.3, 4.4): CapabilityState has exactly the nine values (NOT_APPLICABLE, DEVICE_DISABLED, UNSUPPORTED, NOT_ENROLLED, POLICY_DISABLED, COLLECTION_FAILED, UNKNOWN, NOT_CONFIGURED, AVAILABLE) -- NOT_SHIPPED is a SurfaceOmissionReason, never a state; CapabilityQualifier has exactly the seven; a test proves lexical disjointness from the job vocabularies X1 (queued/running/succeeded/failed/blocked/skipped) and X2 (OP.2 action states) and from utils.action_taxonomy tokens. A serializer emits only under the keys capability_state / capability_qualifiers -- a bare state string never crosses a boundary.

AC-3 Stage 1 (5.1, 5.1.1, 5.1.2): CX1 only from I10 (two incompatible type/vendor resolutions for one canonical id); RI-2 reuses utils.registry_evidence_reconciliation.detect_ri2 (M10.1), not a reimplementation; RI-1 only when the K1-K6 precedence table (5.1.1, rows 1-6, evaluated in order) reaches row 6. A parametrized test covers all six rows including mixed cases (a FALSE on K1/K2 beats an UNESTABLISHED elsewhere; a known mismatch beats an unknown one). CX1 subject scoping per 5.1.2 is represented in the result (which subject is disputed), even though action gating (stage 5) is out of scope.

AC-4 Stage 2 primary ladder (5.2): ranks 0-11 implemented first-match-wins exactly as the table; AVAILABLE is reachable only via rank 10's full conjunction; rank 11 UNKNOWN(unclassified_input) catches absent/malformed input -- never coerced to a default; D5=POLICY_UNKNOWN never reaches rank 11 and yields SCHEDULE_UNKNOWN; every UNKNOWN carries its named missing fact / reason code. One test per rank plus the rank-8-vs-9 fail-closed ordering.

AC-5 Stage 3 qualifiers (4.3, 4.1.5): STALE(as_of) only from D6a fresh==false with a real anchor; PARTIAL only from D6b partial; SOURCE_TRUST_LIMITED only from D6d with its source reason code; IDENTITY_TRANSLATION_REQUIRED only from D6e with its reason code and never promoted to CX1 on its own; NOT_SCHEDULED only from D5 NO_APPLICABLE_SCHEDULE; SCHEDULE_UNKNOWN from POLICY_UNKNOWN; MEMBER_SPECIFIC from I15. The four inference bans (4.1.5) each have a negative test.

AC-6 Boundaries: pure functions over a typed input record (D1-D6, I10, I14 K1-K6, I15); no I/O, no device contact, no reading of registry/evidence files inside the resolver (callers supply inputs); nothing wired into html_export, console, payloads or navigation; utils/capability_registry.py (the 0.6.1C collection planner -- a different concept) is neither extended nor imported. Stages 4-5 (evidence presentation, action affordance) are explicitly the next slice.

AC-7 Validation and state: targeted test module green; tests/test_m10_1_registry_evidence_reconciliation.py and tests/test_architecture_convergence.py unchanged and green; project-state bookkeeping (build_history, roadmap now_next, CURRENT_STATE.md, AI_HANDOVER.md, INDEX.md) lands in this PR. Two other movements run in parallel (GOV.PO.3 orchestrator, OP.1 contract): merge origin/main before opening/merging the PR and resolve bookkeeping conflicts yourself -- they are mechanical.
